definitions.explanation: Meeting the formal conditions or requirements for a role, status, or program. Used in official, legal, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{適格|てきかく}だ。
examples.english: He is well qualified to be a leader.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応募|おうぼ}{者|しゃ}→応募者：20440_oubosha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{適格|てきかく}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たさない→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{不適格|ふてきかく}→不適格：24253_futekikaku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{扱|あつか}われます→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
examples.english: If you do not meet the conditions, you will be treated as ineligible.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {適格|てきかく}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: eligible person, qualified candidate
- {適格|てきかく}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧: eligibility, suitability
- ⟦{不適格|ふてきかく}→不適格：24253_futekikaku⟧: ineligible, unqualified
- {適格|てきかく}{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}: qualified invoice (for consumption-tax credit)

WATCH OUT:
⟦{的確|てきかく}→的確：04536_tekikaku⟧ (accurate, precise: ⟦{的確|てきかく}→的確：04536_tekikaku⟧な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧) has the same reading. {適格|てきかく} is about meeting requirements; ⟦{的確|てきかく}→的確：04536_tekikaku⟧ is about hitting the mark.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{適任|てきにん}→適任：16224_tekinin⟧: well suited to a post by ability or character (⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{適任|てきにん}→適任：16224_tekinin⟧だ); {適格|てきかく} is about meeting stated requirements
